module.purpose: Defines the Mutation class and supporting state/action types for managing individual asynchronous mutations in a query-cache library, handling state transitions, observers, retry execution, and lifecycle GC.
module.summary: This file implements the core Mutation entity used by the query-core library. It models a mutation as a state machine driven by a reducer (#dispatch) that processes actions (pending, success, error, failed, pause, continue). The Mutation class coordinates observers, integrates with a Retryer to run the user-provided mutationFn, and invokes both cache-level and per-mutation callbacks (onMutate, onSuccess, onError, onSettled). It also manages garbage collection via a base Removable class and provides a default idle state factory.
module.businessContext: Part of a data-fetching/caching client (React Query core). Mutations power server-state writes; defects break optimistic updates, cache notifications, and UI consistency.
